roster_note: Hump yard, control tower, wagon repair shed.
logistics_program: a large open working surface with a defined vehicle route
a low workshop or office building at the yard edge
inspection pits or racking appropriate to what the yard handles
sorted stacks or rows of the yard's material
a gate house controlling the single entrance
circulation: one gate, one vehicle loop, no dead ends for a long vehicle
damage_constraints: the yard is still sorted; the sorting has simply stopped mid-task
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the sorting logic is inferable from the arrangement of what is stacked
